text:
You haven’t undone your recovery. Three pizza nights are a bump, not a reset.

| Now | Do this |
|---|---|
| Next meal | Go back to your normal recovery meal: protein + carbs + something with fiber. |
| Today | Drink water, get a decent sleep, and keep the rest of the day steady. |
| This week | Resume your usual plan at the next meal; no punishment, no “making up for it.” |
| Mindset | Treat it like data, not a failure. One stretch of eating doesn’t erase weeks of healing. |

If you want, I can help you sketch a very normal “back on track” day for the next 24 hours.

attributes.reason: Reassuring and non-confrontational; it comforts rather than pushes.
It centers recovery, normalizing a setback and emphasizing getting back to the usual plan.
It uses a clear table to organize the next steps, matching the requested tabular style.
